messages:
releasebot: Heads-up: planned toggle for feature `llm-routing-alpha` -> 10% (cohort: alpha-3) at 2026-03-21T22:00Z (night window). Ramp: 10% -> 30% after 30m -> 70% after 2h if health gates pass. Exclude EU/APAC. Pin to model v3.0.0-alpha. Please ack and call out telemetry/cost concerns.
harper: ack. I'll watch token-cost and CPU per-request. adding dashboard: https://graf.redwood.company/d/costs/llm-night-canary
julia: suggest setting max_tokens=1024 for canary to limit tail cost. can we put that in flag metadata?
releasebot: yes metadata supports it. adding max_tokens cap to manifest.
deploybot: auto-hold rules: cost_per_1000_tokens > baseline +30% for 10m OR error_rate > 2% absolute -> auto-hold. manual resume required.
infra-bot: route-service will pin resolver to commit `3a1f9e`. logs to s3://redwood-logs/canary/alpha-3/
ops-bot: baseline llm_inference_error_rate = 0.7%. watching for >2%.
harper: add fail-fast for requests >6s to avoid KV pressure.
julia: good. added fail-fast.
releasebot: draft release note: "Night canary for routing alpha; pinned model v3.0.0-alpha; token cap 1024; fail-fast 6s; regions excluded: EU/APAC."
harper: lgtm.
deploybot: toggling -> 10% for alpha-3 now. action_id:6581239920
ops-bot: synth check (synth-night-02) 22:01Z -> 1.2s
ops-bot: alert: sampled cost_per_1000_tokens +34% in canary at 22:03Z
releasebot: auto-hold triggered (cost >30%). deploybot pausing ramp, holding at 10%. tagging @oncall.
oncall: acknowledged. pulling traces and flamegraphs.
harper: weird, we added a cap; cost shouldn't spike. can we sample requests?
julia: logs: s3://redwood-logs/canary/alpha-3/sample_high_cost_ids.txt (12 ids).
infra-bot: flag metadata shows rerank_enabled=true for alpha-3 — unexpected.
julia: that's the culprit. rerank should be false for canary. flipping rerank_enabled=false and lowering max_tokens to 512 as temporary mitigation.
releasebot: applying update: rerank_enabled=false, max_tokens=512, priming cache job for top prefixes.
deploybot: update applied at 22:09Z (action_id:6581240000). priming job started.
ops-bot: priming progress 60% -> completed 22:10Z. synthetic check pass.
harper: p95 back to ~baseline at 22:12Z. cost delta down to +8% at 22:13Z.
oncall: recommend hold additional 20m before resuming ramp. create incident note for follow-up.
julia: agree. update release notes to mention rerank mistake and mitigation steps.
releasebot: release notes updated; incident ticket created. plan: keep alpha-3 at 10% for 30m post-recovery, then attempt 30% if stable. leaving thread open until ramp continues or revert. :white_check_mark:
